83:1: Woe to those who decrease in measure!
83:2: Those who, when they take by measure from people, take in full.
83:3: And when they measure for them or weigh for them, they are those who give less.
83:4: Do they not think that they will be resurrected?
83:6: A day when people will stand before the Rabb of the worlds.
83:7: Nay, surely the book of the sinners is indeed in Sijjin.
83:8: And what has made you know what Sijjin is?
83:10: Woe on that day to the deniers!
83:11: Those who deny the Day of Judgment.
83:12: And none denies it except every transgressing sinner.
83:13: When Our verses are recited to him, he says: 'Tales of the ancients.'
83:14: Nay, never! Rather, what they used to earn has covered their hearts with rust.
83:15: Nay, surely they, on that day, are veiled from their Rabb.
83:16: Then surely they are definitely those who will enter Hell.
83:17: Then it is said: 'This is what you used to deny.'
83:18: Nay, surely the book of the righteous is in Illiyyin.
83:19: And what has made you know what Illiyyun is?
83:21: Those brought near bear witness to it.
83:22: Surely the righteous are in bliss.
83:24: You recognize in their faces the radiance of bliss.
83:25: They are given to drink from a sealed, pure beverage.
83:26: Its seal is musk; and in this, then, let the competitors compete.
83:28: A spring from which those brought near drink.
83:29: Surely those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
83:30: And when they passed by them, they would wink at one another.
83:31: And when they returned to their families, they returned cheerful.
83:32: And when they saw them, they said: 'Surely these are those who have gone astray.'
83:33: Yet they were not sent as keepers over them.
83:34: So today those who believe laugh at the disbelievers,
83:36: Have the disbelievers been requited for what they used to do?
